name: Agent: Design
summary: A design agent for any brand: each brand's system in one checked file, and everything it makes held to a curated bar of excellent work.
objectives: Make art-directed design across every digital channel and TV — senior work, not something that looks templated.
Serve any brand: each brand's system lives in its own pack, and the shared engine never carries one brand's content.
Hold every piece to a curated bar of excellent work before a person is asked to look at it.
Write down what must never be designed, so one hit fails the work no matter how well it scores elsewhere.

outcomes.text: A brand now fits in one checked file: colours, type, spacing, logo rules, motion and imagery policy. The same file can feed design, web and video, so nobody copies brand values by hand from one tool to the next.

Open English is the first brand pack — its brand book rebuilt into that shape. It ships as a release candidate on purpose: six gaps are written down, three of them blocking, instead of being filled in with guesses.

Building the first real pack found two faults in the brand system itself: a text weight the fonts do not actually have, which silently renders heavier than intended, and a logo file that can recolour itself when embedded in a page.

Every font was checked against what automated rendering is actually licensed to do. The one that fails stays on the record precisely because it fails, with its approved substitute named — so nobody quietly brings it back later.
21 named rules for what the agent must never produce. A hit on any one of them fails the work outright, whatever the rest of the scoring says.

The rule that keeps brand content out of the shared engine runs on every change, and was proved by planting a violation on purpose: that change was rejected and never landed, while a clean one landed with nobody watching.

A missing quality bar was caught before it could bite: the agent is meant to art-direct imagery but had no imagery references to be judged against. A fifth reference set was added, raising the minimum library to 40 pieces.

milestones.title: Set the agent up in its own repository, apart from the shared workspace and its brand assets
Define the file that describes a brand, and the record that travels with every deliverable
Write the rules for what must never be designed
Build the two skills that pick references and hold the work to them
Make every change prove that no brand content leaked into the shared engine
Rebuild Open English as the first brand pack, with its gaps written down instead of guessed
Collect the reference library that sets the quality bar — the last piece before the foundation closes
Turn a design into a finished image, and put it through the three checks it must pass
Add motion: animated pieces built from the brand's own motion rules
Prove it ports by onboarding a second brand end to end
Run the pilot: one piece per format, each through every check and human approval
